mentions.name: Scenema
mentions.description: Scenema is a platform for creating whiteboard and 2D animated explainer videos. It addresses character and voice consistency in AI video generation, where models can only produce 5-15 second clips, and can generate minutes-long explainers (up to 30 minutes) with studio-level animation across whiteboard and 2D styles.
mentions.problem: Traditional animated explainers are very expensive to produce and time consuming, and AI video models' short clip lengths (5-15 seconds) make managing characters and voices for longer videos incredibly difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small tema and I are currently building https://scenema.ai, a platform for creating whiteboard and 2D animated explainers. We initially started Scenema to deal with character and voice consistency in cinematic AI videos. Most video models can only  generate  5-10 second clips.
